As a depositor, I want to save an in-progress deposit as a draft and resume it later, so that I do not lose my work if interrupted.
As a collection curator, I want to review and approve or reject items submitted by depositors before they become publicly visible, so that I can ensure metadata quality and appropriate content.
As a collection curator, I want to batch edit descriptive metadata for multiple items using a spreadsheet or CSV file, so that I can correct or enrich metadata efficiently.

As a collection curator, I want to set or inherit access permissions at the component level independently from the parent item, so that I can restrict specific files while allowing discovery of other components.
As a repository manager, I want to receive alerts when a remote replication job fails or falls outside the expected schedule, so that I can intervene to protect preservation copies.
As a depositor, I want to receive email or dashboard notifications when my deposit is submitted, approved, rejected, or published, so that I can track its status.
As a collection curator, I want to preview how an item page appears to public, authenticated, and curator roles before publishing or after changing permissions, so that I can verify access settings.
As a DigitalRecords Archivist, I want to correct metadata, replace files, and reindex an ingested ETD after batch ingest, so that I can fix errors without re-submitting the entire batch.

As a collection curator, I want to mint DOIs and assign them to items or components that lack identifiers, including bulk assignment, so that I can ensure all citable objects have persistent identifiers.
As a collection curator, I want to configure collection-specific metadata fields and controlled vocabularies, so that deposit forms capture descriptive metadata appropriate to that collection.

As a repository manager, I want to view an audit trail of permission changes, administrative actions, and deletion events for items and collections, so that I can investigate security or compliance issues.
As a collection curator, I want to receive a list or dashboard alert of embargoed items nearing their release or expiration date, so that I can extend or confirm the embargo.
As a repository manager, I want to require secondary approval before scheduled deletion or hiding of expired content is executed, so that irreversible deletions are not performed accidentally.

As a collection curator, I want to attach collection-level documentation files such as policies, data dictionaries, and README files for public display, so that users understand how the collection may be used.
As a depositor, I want to see required metadata and file validation checks before I finalize a submission, so that I can fix problems before deposit instead of receiving post-ingest errors.
As a collection curator, I want to manage access requests from users by approving or denying them and setting an expiration date, so that restricted objects can be shared securely for a limited time.
As a repository manager, I want to set storage quotas for collections or financial contacts and alert curators when they approach the limit, so that storage growth is controlled.

As a repoadmin, I want to configure and manage single sign-on authentication via Duke NetID or other institutional identity providers for staff and depositors, so that users can use existing credentials.
As a visitor, I want to generate a formatted citation for an item and export it to EndNote, Zotero, or BibTeX, so that I can cite it accurately.
As a collection curator, I want to create and manage relationships between items and components, such as version-of, part-of, and related-to, so that users can navigate related materials.

As a DigitalRecords Archivist, I want to automatically synchronize deposit group membership with institutional course rosters or department directories, so that permissions stay current without manual updates.

As a collection curator, I want to use external authority services such as ORCID, VIAF, or LCNAF to disambiguate authors and update authority records, so that related works by the same person are linked.
As a repository manager, I want to periodically verify file checksums and receive reports of fixity failures, so that I can detect and repair corrupted files.
As a repository manager, I want to export collection metadata and files for preservation or transfer to another system, so that we can migrate content or comply with records retention requirements.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to receive spoken public-transport updates such as delays or platform changes, so that I can adjust my trip.
details.reason: Public transport support exists but real-time delay or change updates are not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to warn me if I leave home without my keys, wallet, or medication, so that I avoid daily problems.
details.reason: ALFRED warns about low battery when leaving, but not about other essential items.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to set a one-command morning routine that turns on lights, reads the weather, and lists my first appointments, so that I can start my day with one interaction.
details.reason: Individual controls and reminders exist, but no combined routine command is described.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to control smart-home devices by named room, so that I do not accidentally change the wrong light or heater.
details.reason: Smart-home controls exist, but room-based naming and targeted control are not mentioned.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want ALFRED to remind me to charge itself when I am at home and the battery is low, so that it is ready when I go out.
details.reason: Low battery is announced when leaving, but no proactive at-home charging reminder exists.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to set a cooking timer and receive a spoken alert when time is up, so that I do not forget food on the stove.
details.reason: Cooking is a domain of interest, but a practical safety timer is not specified.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to create a shared shopping list that my family or caregiver can update, so that I get the right items.
details.reason: Grocery shopping is supported, but collaborative list management is not covered.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to request an accessible route that avoids stairs and steep hills, so that I can walk safely.
details.reason: Navigation exists but no accessibility-preference-based route is described.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to play a cognitive game at a difficulty level I choose, so that I can train without becoming frustrated.
details.reason: Cognitive games exist, but difficulty selection is not specified.

details.story: As an OlderPerson, I want to receive a daily summary of my physical activity and exercise, so that I know how much I have done.
details.reason: Exercise tracking and feedback exist, but no daily summary for the user is mentioned.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to set personalised vital-sign alert thresholds for each user, so that I am notified only when values are outside safe ranges.
details.reason: Vital signs are measured, but no caregiver-defined thresholds are covered.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive an alert when a user's vital signs deviate from their baseline, so that I can intervene early.
details.reason: Vital signs are monitored, but baseline-deviation alerts are missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to view a chronological log of a user's vital measurements and alerts, so that I can review their condition over time.
details.reason: Individual measurements exist, but no timeline or event log is specified for caregivers.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to remotely adjust the user's exercise plan based on their progress, so that the plan stays appropriate.
details.reason: Exercise training and feedback exist, but no remote adjustment workflow is described.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to annotate a vital event or exercise session with notes, so that the care team has context.
details.reason: Vital and exercise data are collected, but no caregiver annotation feature exists.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to track whether a user has completed prescribed exercises and reminders, so that I can follow adherence.
details.reason: Exercise reminders and summaries exist, but per-user completion tracking is not explicit.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a suspected fall alert with location and time, so that I can respond quickly.
details.reason: Fall detection sends alerts, but no location/time-enriched caregiver alert is specified.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to schedule a virtual check-in with the user, so that I can monitor them without travel.
details.reason: Videophone and emergency video calls exist, but scheduled remote check-ins are missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to view the user's medication adherence remotely, so that I can identify missed doses.
details.reason: Medication reminders and user-facing pill status exist, but caregiver adherence visibility is not covered.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to receive a low battery alert for a user's ALFRED device, so that I know why monitoring may be interrupted.
details.reason: Battery status is user-facing, but caregiver notification is not mentioned.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to register the patient's baseline measurements during onboarding, so that later alerts are personalised.
details.reason: Vital monitoring exists, but baseline setup for personalisation is missing.

details.story: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to generate a full health summary report of the user's data to share in a consultation, so that I can save time.
details.reason: Exercise summaries exist, but a complete health report is not specified.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to set social activity reminders based on the client's interests and calendar, so that they do not miss meaningful events.
details.reason: Social activity suggestions and general reminders exist, but caregiver-defined social reminders are missing.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to see the user's self-reported mood or stress, so that I can adapt my care and escalate if needed.
details.reason: Stress can be sensed, but no simple self-reported mood/well-being view is specified.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to manage a list of care tasks for each client, so that I can remember their individual needs.
details.reason: A caregiver reminder exists for bringing items, but no per-client task list is covered.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to receive a summary of the user's daily activity and outings, so that I can discuss their social participation.
details.reason: Activity level is monitored, but no social-caregiver daily summary of outings is mentioned.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to create an itinerary for an outing with step-by-step support for the older person, so that both know the plan.
details.reason: Outing and transport support exist, but no shared itinerary creation is described.

details.story: As a SocialCaregiver, I want to be notified if the user misses a planned social event or appointment, so that I can follow up.
details.reason: Event invitations and reminders exist, but no caregiver notification for missed events is covered.

details.story: As an InformalCaregiver, I want to receive updates about my relative's daily well-being, so that I can feel reassured without calling constantly.
details.reason: Family communication and caregiver monitoring exist, but informal-caregiver daily updates are missing.

details.story: As an InformalCaregiver, I want to set up joint reminders or tasks with the older person, so that we can support each other.
details.reason: Reminders exist for users and social caregivers, but informal caregiver joint reminders are not covered.

details.story: As an InformalCaregiver, I want to view the activities my relative has completed, so that I can encourage them.
details.reason: Exercise activities are monitored by medical caregivers, but informal caregiver visibility is not specified.

details.story: As an InformalCaregiver, I want to configure which notifications I receive from ALFRED, so that I am informed without being overwhelmed.
details.reason: Notifications exist in several roles, but no informal-caregiver preference settings are mentioned.

details.story: As an InformalCaregiver, I want to request a video call or send a voice message to my relative through ALFRED, so that communication is easy.
details.reason: Older-person video calls and messaging exist, but informal caregiver-initiated communication is not explicit.

details.story: As a developer, I want to test my app in a sandbox environment before publishing, so that I can catch errors.
details.reason: App creation and crash reporting exist, but no pre-publication sandbox testing is specified.

details.story: As a developer, I want to version my app releases and roll back to a previous version, so that I can recover from a bad update.
details.reason: App maintenance and state notifications exist, but versioning and rollback are missing.

details.story: As a developer, I want to see user ratings and reviews for my app, so that I can improve it.
details.reason: App presentation and state tracking exist, but user feedback for developers is not covered.

details.story: As a developer, I want to access analytics about how users interact with my app, so that I can identify usability issues.
details.reason: Crash details and support exist, but usage analytics are not specified.

details.story: As a developer, I want to define the permissions and privacy requests my app requires, so that I can request only what is necessary.
details.reason: Developers design their own apps, but explicit permission definition is not covered.

details.story: As a developer, I want to localize my app content for different languages, so that it can serve older users in their native language.
details.reason: App presentation is flexible, but language localization is not mentioned.

details.story: As a developer, I want to deactivate or unpublish my app, so that it is no longer offered if I choose to stop supporting it.
details.reason: App state changes are notified, but a developer-initiated unpublish action is missing.

details.story: As a Cornell faculty member, I want to link my deposited data to the DOI of the related publication, so that the article and data are mutually discoverable.
details.reason: Existing association stories cover publication association and related files but not external DOI linking.

details.story: As a repository support team member, I want to merge duplicate item records, so that I can keep the catalog clean when the same work is deposited more than once.
details.reason: Existing support-team stories handle export and collection moves but not duplicate merging.

details.story: As a DB/IR administrator, I want to configure which report or dataset categories require review before publication, so that I can enforce approval workflows for controlled content.
details.reason: Existing admin stories manage accounts and reports but not configurable approval workflows.

details.story: As a library staff member, I want to include a covering note to the author when uploading material on their behalf, so that the author understands what was deposited and why.
details.reason: Existing mediated deposit stories do not include author communication.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to subscribe to an RSS or Atom feed for a collection or search, so that I can automatically learn of new works matching my interests.
details.reason: Existing notification stories cover teaching faculty and report email alerts but not researcher feed subscriptions.

details.story: As a patron, I want to access an accessible transcript or alternative format for audio-visual materials, so that I can use repository content regardless of disability.
details.reason: Existing streaming and format stories focus on media delivery but not accessibility alternatives.

details.story: As a library staff member, I want to record geographic coverage for extension resources, so that users can find materials relevant to their region.
details.reason: Existing extension story makes resources available across New York State but does not include geographic metadata.

details.story: As an external user, I want to select a preferred language for the repository interface and metadata, so that I can navigate and interpret content in a familiar language.
details.reason: Existing external-user stories address discovery and access but not language preferences.

details.story: As a data curator, I want a review queue for deposits awaiting approval, so that I can ensure metadata and files meet repository standards before they go live.
details.reason: Existing data-curator stories cover versioning and records scheduling but not a curation review workflow.

details.story: As a library staff member, I want to change the owning unit or collection of an item after deposit, so that I can correct organizational changes without re-uploading.
details.reason: Existing move story covers moving an entire collection but not reassigning an item.

details.story: As a Cornell faculty member, I want to see usage of my items by geographic region or referring source, so that I can understand the reach of my work beyond total download counts.
details.reason: Existing analytics stories are for library staff and per-item download notices, not author-facing breakdowns.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to limit a search to files with a specific license, such as CC-BY or CC0, so that I can find content suitable for reuse.
details.reason: Existing reuse-rights stories display licenses but do not allow searching by license.

details.story: As a library staff member, I want to set access restrictions at individual file level within an item, so that metadata remains discoverable while the file stays restricted.
details.reason: Existing embargo stories apply at the item level but not to specific files.

details.story: As an Extension Administrator, I want to set a review date for a resource, so that I am reminded to reassess its accuracy or move it to historical status.
details.reason: Existing reminder story covers attention steps but not explicit content review dates.

details.story: As a patron, I want to see whether a report or dataset is available for immediate download or only by request, so that I understand access conditions before selecting it.
details.reason: Existing access stories cover embargoes and remote login but not availability indicators.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to view a list of versions with dates and reasons for change for an item, so that I can assess which version is appropriate for my work.
details.reason: Existing versioning stories allow retaining and viewing multiple versions but do not require a structured change history.

details.story: As a DB/IR administrator, I want to send a test email to a subscriber before activating a report subscription, so that I can confirm delivery settings work.
details.reason: Existing patron subscription and administrator account stories do not include subscription testing.

details.story: As a researcher, I want to compare two versions of an item side by side, so that I can see exactly what changed between versions.
details.reason: Existing versioning stories let users view separate versions but do not offer side-by-side comparison.

details.story: As a stakeholder, I want a plain-language summary of preservation risks and recovery procedures, so that I can make informed decisions about digital asset longevity.
details.reason: Existing preservation assurance stories address technical redundancy but not stakeholder-friendly reporting.

details.story: As an asset manager, I want to receive an annual inventory report of all deposited assets and their preservation status, so that I can demonstrate compliance and plan for remediation.
details.reason: Existing asset stories require asset listing and monitoring but not scheduled reporting.

details.story: As a data curator, I want to add preservation file formats alongside original uploads, so that content remains renderable in future operating environments.
details.reason: Existing rendering description story addresses description but not creation of preservation copies.
